app.title: OA Screening
home.title: Knee osteoarthritis screening
home.body: A guided check of knee movement, walking and an X-ray, to flag early signs of osteoarthritis. Takes about five minutes.

kl.title: Grade probability
res.title: Result
res.overallNote: Equal-weighted average of whichever of the three checks below were completed — not a validated combined score.
risk.low.body: No strong indicators of osteoarthritis were found in this screening. Encourage continued activity and joint care.
risk.moderate.body: Some indicators consistent with early or moderate osteoarthritis risk. Clinical assessment is recommended.
risk.high.body: Several indicators consistent with advanced osteoarthritis risk. Referral for clinical assessment is recommended.
guide.title: Preventive guidance
guide.body: Keep moving daily within comfortable limits. Strengthen the thigh muscles. Maintain a healthy weight to reduce load on the knee. Avoid prolonged squatting and deep knee bending. Eat a balanced diet with enough calcium and vitamin D. Report worsening pain, swelling or locking to a health worker.
